response: The transverse apex does not always coincide with coronal apex levels (regional or global) in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis. In fact, the most rotated level may be as far as two levels from the global apex and one level from the regional apex. This suggests that the regional or global apex of a given curve is not always the most rotated level, and there can be variation in the alignment of the transverse and coronal apices.
